title: Geometry-Adaptive Explainer for Faithful Dictionary-Based Interpretability under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2605.21849v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability aims to explain a model's behavior by identifying causally responsible internal structures. Dictionary-based explainers such as sparse autoencoders and transcoders are a primary tool, but their faithfulness under out-of-distribution (OOD) shift has received little systematic attention. We show that distribution shift rotates the subspace that the model actively uses, misaligning the explainer's dictionary trained on in-distribution (ID) activations. We formalize this misalignment as the faithfulness gap, a geometric distance between the ID dictionary and the OOD-active subspace, and show that it bounds excess OOD projection loss. To reduce this gap, we propose the Geometry-Adaptive Explainer (GAE), which realigns the dictionary with the OOD-active subspace while preserving the original sparse feature activations. translated_title: 面向分布偏移下忠实词典可解释性的几何自适应解释器
translated_abstract: 机械可解释性旨在通过识别因果相关的内部结构来解释模型的行为。基于词典的解释器（如稀疏自编码器和转码器）是其中的主要工具，但它们在分布外（OOD）偏移下的忠实性却很少受到系统性关注。我们证明，分布偏移会旋转模型实际使用的子空间，导致在分布内（ID）激活上训练的解释器词典发生错位。我们将这种错位形式化为“忠实性差距”，即ID词典与OOD活跃子空间之间的几何距离，并证明该差距约束了额外的OOD投影损失。为了减小这一差距，我们提出了几何自适应解释器（GAE），它在保留原始稀疏特征激活的同时，将词典与OOD活跃子空间重新对齐。该方法仅需要无标签的OOD激活，且无需任何梯度更新。
tldr: 提出几何自适应解释器（GAE），仅用无标签的分布外激活、无需梯度更新即可将词典重新对齐到OOD活跃子空间，从而量化并减小分布偏移下的忠实性差距。
